conversations:
Leave, intruder.~ We have nothing to speak of, leave this place.~ We are a peaceful people, but that could change the more intruders like you show up.~ Touch our nytlings, and you're dead, intruder.~ You don't belong here, leave.~ This is our home, and we'll do everything we can to protect it.~ Leave this place.~
...
You've done much for us, friend. But that doesn't mean we aren't watching you.~ Watch yourself, traveler.~ The safety of our kin is tantamount to anything.~ For your own wellbeing, behave.~ I respect you, wanderer, but that doesn't mean you own the place. Stay in line.~ We don't need wardens, we protect our kind on our own terms.~
...
How did you get in here, you aren't welcome!~ You are not wanted in this place, leave!~ Please, leave us alone, we've had enough trouble from outsiders.~ An outsider? How did you get in here?~ Another intruder, are you here to steal our nytlings too?~ Please, leave us be. Our hearts hurt enough.
...
I have nytlings to dote over, friend.~ you can hear them crying in their shells.~ Watch your footing in the brood-chambers, every nyt is precious.~ There is brood to tend, friend.~ No time for talk, hatchlings need care!~
...
We've closed our gates for a reason, the outside world is no longer welcome. You should leave.~ We're pained people right now, we don't want outsiders here.~ You've wandered somewhere you are not wanted, wanderer.~ If my sacchar wasn't so tight, I'd chase you out myself!~
You're unwelcome here, outsider.~ Never seen you before, you here to steal our nyts too?~ A thief just ruined our lives, and now we're letting your type in? Why?~ Leave here, please. We don't need anymore heartache.~ Have we not learned our lesson, why are you here?~ I thought we locked our gates?~ Leave, please.~ You will get no welcome here, outsider.~
...
Beware the pretty-water, friend.~ The crystholt water-holes are clear as crystal, drink them, and you'll go clear too.~ Cryst-water may look fresh but slake your thirst on that a crysten-effigy will take your place in no time.~ The shiny-baubles near the ponds should warn enough, beware the crystna. Their fumes turn all to glitter.~
Crystna vines might reach out and snatch you. Beware the cryst-weed.~
May your dream-realms be calm and serene, friend.~ Dream in serenity, friend.~ Yes, I dreamt of this conversation, dream-friend.~ I dreamt of this meet, friend.~ Welcome to the eternal Rhem, dream-friend.~ The groves are where we worship the eternal dream-walkers, friend.~
{{emote|*nibbles on crispy shard-leaf*}}~ {{emote|*nips at crunchy chitin-chips*}}~ Might grab some sacchar-chips from chymero's today.~ I'm craving ollah, friend.~ Amrita over eggs-benedict, the thought makes my bellies rumble.~ Mantra-ray flank steaks, a sprinkle of roe, some cryst-tree sap on the side. The meal-thought is maddening, friend.~ Careful with the mad-honey, friend, the mind-journeys aren't always fun.~ I'm bringing brimberries for my youngers.~ The brimraisin's might reek, but they are divine.~
The Crystholts are pure again. The bloodpools have gone still, thank you, =name=.~ The amalgam are still, lifeless. Was this you?~ The bloodpits have calcified, how is this possible?~ The Scour? Are they gone, can we walk the crystholts safely once again?~ For the first time in many moons, I walked the paths of the cryst, unbothered by the scours. All thanks to you, friend.~ Your name is legend here, freind. You saved us from the bloodpits!~ Such joy, I can tend the crytus again!~ Joyful days for us, freind. The world is open to us once more, all thanks to you!~ What nightmare did you face below? What must you've slain to make the bloodpits go dark?~ The slayer of Scour approaches, live and drink well, friend.~

Beware the blood-pits, friend.~ Pits of anguish amongst the cryst, their amalgam scour the lands, murdering and capturing mortal-flesh. They drag you in and your flesh melds with theirs.~ The blood-pits will take you if you are not careful, friend.~ I grieve, one of our own was dragged into the pits, again. We see their faces amongst the Scouer.~ We lost another to the blood-pits. Why does this dream's cruelty wrought such illness on our lands?~
...
{{emote|*giggles as they look you over*}}~ {{emote|*chews on brimberry raisins*}}~
Oi, where's yah 'tennae, tall friend? Did you lose 'em?~ Yah! Soft-shell faces look so smooth!~ Wah! Your head-bobbers are gone!~ Yah don't walk on stilt-legs like me!~ You a' wanderer? What's the outah-wilds like?~ You ever had olfah? Is my favorite!~ Your eyes have dots in 'em?~ What's those comin' out the side of yah head?~ You smell funny ...~ You look kinda funny, hehe!~ You lose your molt or somethin'?~ You musta molted last moon? Your skin's still soft!~ What's them bobblies on your stimmies? Looks gross, yeah?~ Why yah eyes so smol?~ Can'yah buy me some brimberries? Please?~ Wantin sum'thin sweet sum'thin fierce I am!~ Don't get swollowed by the Scour!~ I want to visit a grove, but fam says it's too dangerous.~ Once durin' story time, shah told us how there are legends who walk our dreams. I wanna walk people's dreams too!~ They say at the groves, you can commune with the Dreamwalkers? What's that mean?~
